faq_heading: Homes near Godson Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Godson Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Abbotsford School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Godson Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Godson Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Godson Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 130 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $937,500, townhomes $695,000, condos $401,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Godson Elementary?
faq.a: For the 130 homes that sold within 1 km of Godson Elementary, the median time on the market was 26 days and the median sale was 96.5% of list; 5% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Godson Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Abbotsford Middle School (0.3 km east), Abbotsford Senior Secondary School (0.6 km north-east) and Centennial Park Elementary (1.1 km north-west).

Godson Elementary is an elementary school in Abbotsford (Abbotsford School District), at 33130 Bevan Ave. It teaches grades K to 5.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Godson Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Godson Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Godson Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Godson Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 130 homes sold within 1 km of Godson Elementary: 16 houses, 8 townhomes and 106 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $401,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Godson Elementary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Godson Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 4 secondary, 3 middle, 2 other; 1 independent). The closest is Abbotsford Middle School, 0.3 km away, and the farthest on this list is Ten Broeck Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Centennial Park Elementary (1.1 km); the nearest secondary school is Abbotsford Senior Secondary School (0.6 km); the nearest independent school is West Coast Adventist Online School (1.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Centennial Park Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Jackson Elementary (1.1 km south), Alexander Elementary (1.4 km east), Terry Fox Elementary (1.9 km north), John Maclure Community School (1.9 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-5) is Centennial Park Elementary, 1.1 km north-west of Godson Elementary.
